===Quotes===
Start of turn:
When asleep:
"Sleeping still."
With low health or a status ailment: 
"This looks dangerous."
When victory is near:
"This looks promising."
Otherwise:
"I will advance." 

Start of battle:
When attacking a castle: 
"Out of my way!"
When defending a castle: 
"A challenge. Excellent."

During battle:
" and I will claim glory... On this field of battle!"

When ordering to attack: 
" ! Do it."

When ordering to go to battle: 
To a kingdom:
"None can stop me! No matter how many they number!"
To a wild Pokémon location:
"Right, we're off!"

Upon forming a link: 
"Come, . You're with me now."

When using an item: 
"My will help."

When using his Warrior Skill: 
"Learn of my might the hard way!"

After winning a battle: 
If he attacked a castle:
"You see, our path led us through to victory."
If he defended a castle:
"Challenge us again sometime. We shall always take you on gladly."

When defeated:
If recruitable:
"Hm. You are a fine Warrior."
If defeated by something other than the enemy:
"Hmm..."
Otherwise:
"How could I be forced to retreat...?"

When being recruited:
"You desire my service? Very well."

When delegating:
Before a delegation is chosen:
"What shall I do for you?"
After a delegation is chosen:
""Leave it to me."
When a delegation isn't chosen:
"I understand."

When mining:
When about to mine:
"Let us begin."
When successful in mining:
"Well done."
"Yes."
"Good."
When unsuccessful in mining:
"I see."

After linking with :
"So this is the legendary power of the Warrior Crystal... I've never seen such power in a Pokémon before... So, let's see how powerful you really are... Come with me, Dialga!"

At the end of :
"Fine work, Ina."
"You won the contest. That means you have talent. But you mustn't forget. Talent alone is not enough."

===Profile===
A famous Warrior, thought to be the strongest in all of Ransei. Valued as an ally, his enemies fear the day when they have to take him on.

==In the manga==
===Pokémon + Nobunaga's Ambition ~ Ranse's Color Picture Scroll ~===
Tadakatsu debuted in PNA6.
 
====Pokémon====
 

==Trivia==

===Historical origin===
Tadakatsu is based on the real-life of Japanese history, who had a reputation of being an unbeatable samurai - evading all injury across his many battles. This earned him recognition from influential figures of the time, such as Nobunaga ( ), Hideyoshi ( ), and Shingen ( ).

His Steel specialty in Conquest may reference his service under Ieyasu.
